description: Show which chat networks are offered and the plan's chat-app allowance (GET /v1/bridges/networks): networks (network, name, status offered or beta, offered) and allowance (plan, paid_plan, limit, used: bridges set up or running, remaining, can_create: whether a new bridge would pass the plan checks, saying nothing about a token). Free plans get 0. With hubId the allowance is the hub owner's, since bridges count against the owner; otherwise the caller's. summary says it in words. Read it before suggesting a new chat app or resuming one the plan paused. Requires the hubs:read scope. Reads only.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

hubId.description: Hub UUID: report the allowance of this hub's owner.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

name: thalovant_get_bridge_networks
title: Get Chat App Allowance
